Achievement unlockedQuick Fix

A small release with two fixes. On Android, the back gesture and the back button work again. And the Mod Store page of a house rule with a starter deck shows the official cards' art again.

one for the Android app and one for the Mod Store.

You asked, we fixed

Issue #998 · PRs #999, #1000
★
Achievement unlockedHulk Gets His Pictures Back

House rule packs show their official cards. The Mod Store page of Don't Make Me Angry!, the one house rule that ships a starter deck, showed its 30 official deck cards as text-only faces. They have their art again, and card hover and Inspect open the full card.

Back works on Android again

In the Android app, the back gesture and the back button did nothing. They step back a screen again: they close an open sheet, open Pause in a game, and send the app to the background from the title screen.
